plugins.name: pm-tactical
plugins.description: Daily-workflow skills for PMs: model routing, self-QA, prompt optimization, MCP context audit, project memory.

plugins.name: pm-verifier
plugins.description: AI Evals for PMs: turn an AI feature spec into a versioned suite, isolated repeated trials, outcome and trajectory grading, calibrated model judgments, failure analysis, and an auditable CI release decision.

plugins.name: mcp-migration-auditor
plugins.description: 2026-07-28 spec readiness scanner: audits MCP configs against verified breaking changes (stateless transport, deprecated capabilities, Tasks migration, OAuth hardening) with per-server BREAKS/DEGRADED/SAFE verdicts and cited fixes.

plugins.name: loop-designer
plugins.description: Guarded autonomous loop generator: turns any recurring task into a five-part loop spec (Discover/Plan/Execute/Verify/Stop) with five non-negotiable guardrails and ready-to-paste Routine + cron runners.

plugins.name: agent-graph-designer
plugins.description: Agent-orchestration graph designer: qualifies loop versus graph, then produces bounded node, typed-edge, handoff, join, shared-state, recovery, budget, permission, verification, and human-approval contracts with synchronized visual, machine-readable, and runnable artifacts.

plugins.name: pm-human-writer
plugins.description: Voice-preserving product-writing editor: removes recognisable AI-writing patterns, protects facts and product judgment, and returns a clean draft with named edits.

plugins.name: ai-feature-kill-criteria
plugins.description: Pre-build AI product decision contract: defines falsifiable assumptions, explicit kill thresholds, the cheapest decisive evidence plan, and a decision date before development starts.
